text:
Asha (People Ops): Samir Patel lands Mon morning and asked if we can deliver laptop to his hotel and do I-9 same day. His passport expired but he says he has a Canadian PR card.

Tom (Recruiter): Samir prefers hotel delivery; worried front desk might misplace package. Can we mark it for guest pickup and include his mobile? Hean come to HQ at 2pm if needed.

Samir (candidate): I can do 2pm at HQ. I have the PR card in hand. Also requested a Hindi intro for first-hour.

Lina (Onboarding): Canadian PR (List A) works for I-9. Plan: in-person I-9 at 2pm with Hindi interpreter. If he can't make, fallback is NotaryNow remote (he must be in US during signing). Please upload PR card photo to secure portal by EOD Fri.

IT-bot: Hotel shipping OK if label exactly: "Hold for: Samir Patel / Redwood Inference - Guest Pickup" + mobile. AUP link will be emailed; asset held until signed.

Background Check Desk: We can start ID-only checks with PR card; SSN pending is OK but may extend verification time. Samir, please sign consent today to avoid delay.

Tom (Recruiter): Confirmed with Samir, he accepts 2pm HQ drop-in and will upload PR card photos now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
